cause_claim: The change adds rule-0291 with criteria on f02 and f21 for template T7. The dependency chain: change → rule-0291 interface → template:T7 (matches_on=f02,f21) → content-pipeline → rule-validator.validate. The rule-validator (ic-0045) checks the rule against template:T7's field_count=21. The rule-validator also enforces a inputs_supplied=20 constraint (ic-0051). Rule-0291 references field f21, which exceeds the 20-field limit enforced by the validator, causing rejection. Baseline experiment x-41215c45e02445e7 had 0 rejections; candidate experiment x-b62718f0eebc4918 rejected 1 rule with message "rule-0291: rejected, fields ['f21'] beyond 20". The rejected rule was held back by validation, so only 3 of 4 rules were shipped to the interpreter (exit_code=0, matches=0).
